# Windfinder

> Windfinder provides real-time wind, weather, waves, and tide forecasts for wind sports and outdoor activities across thousands of global locations.

Windfinder is a comprehensive forecasting platform serving wind sports enthusiasts including kitesurfers, windsurfers, sailors, and paragliders. The platform offers detailed meteorological data powered by the GFS model with bird's-eye view capabilities and location-specific forecasts worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Wind Forecast
- Weather Forecast
- Real-time Conditions
- GFS Model
- Kitesurfing
- Windsurfing
- Paragliding
- Sailing
- Wave Forecast
- Tide Forecast
- Bird's-eye View
- Global Locations
- UTC Time
- Edgar Widmann
- Joe Schanz
